title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah greets PM Modi, India on 80th Independence Day - Business Standard
description: Nepal PM Balendra Shah greets PM Modi, India on 80th Independence Day  Business Standard
publisher.title: Business Standard
full_article:
Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah on Saturday extended greetings and best wishes to his Indian counterpart Narendra Modi and the people of India on the occasion of the country's 80th Independence Day.

Shah's message comes amid Nepal's efforts to strengthen ties with India, with the Himalayan nation seeking greater economic cooperation and connectivity with its immediate neighbour.

"On the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day, I extend my heartfelt greetings and best wishes to PM @narendramodi and the friendly people and Government of India," Shah's office said in a post on X.

Shah's message also comes days after he held his first one-on-one meeting with Indian Ambassador to Nepal Naveen Srivastava on August 10, after having largely avoided such engagements with foreign diplomats since taking office.

"May the deep historical ties, close people-to-people relations and cooperation between Nepal and India continue to strengthen in the years ahead," Shah said on Saturday.

Nepal Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal also extended his greetings to External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar, the people and the government of India on the occasion.

"Nepal and India share deep historical and civilisational ties, close people-to-people relations and a multifaceted partnership. May these bonds continue to grow even stronger in the days ahead," Khanal said in a post on X.

Jaishankar thanked his Nepalese counterpart for the warm wishes.

India is Nepal's largest trading partner and a key source of investment, while the two countries share an open border that facilitates extensive movement of people and deep social and familial ties.

title: Nepal Telecom Reports Significant Profit Growth in Q4 FY 2082/83 - Ratopati
description: Nepal Telecom Reports Significant Profit Growth in Q4 FY 2082/83  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Nepal Telecom has announced a significant increase in net profit by publishing the unaudited financial statement for the fourth quarter of the fiscal year 2082/83. The company has earned a net profit of NPR 8.86 billion 46 lakh during the review period. This amount is an increase of NPR 2.85 billion 79 lakh, or 47.58 percent, compared to the net profit of NPR 6.67 billion in the same period of the previous fiscal year.

According to the financial statement, the company's total operating income has reached NPR 34.95 billion 04 lakh by the fourth quarter of this fiscal year. While the total operating income in the same period of the previous fiscal year was NPR 33.89 billion 45 lakh, this year it has increased by NPR 1.05 billion 59 lakh, or 3.12 percent. Similarly, the company's total income has also increased by 2.65 percent from NPR 38.18 billion 81 lakh last year to NPR 39.19 billion 96 lakh.

Improvements have also been observed in other profit indicators of the company. EBITDA has reached NPR 20.48 billion 01 lakh by the fourth quarter. This is an increase of 10.73 percent compared to NPR 18.49 billion 60 lakh last year. Similarly, profit before tax has increased by 34.66 percent to NPR 13.26 billion 47 lakh. The company's annualized earnings per share have been recorded at NPR 49.25.

Clarifying the main reasons for the changes in revenue and net profit, Telecom stated that interest income has decreased due to a reduction in interest rates. Compared to last year, interest income has decreased by approximately NPR 861.9 million, or 22.88 percent.

On the other hand, revenue from GSM has increased by NPR 645.4 million, or 2.28 percent, contributing to the overall revenue growth. The company has mentioned that as a national communication medium, services are continuously being expanded and quality improved even in remote and inaccessible areas with high costs and low returns.

title: 13 Dead, 5 Missing in Nepal Due to Monsoon Disasters in Last 24 Hours - Ratopati
description: 13 Dead, 5 Missing in Nepal Due to Monsoon Disasters in Last 24 Hours  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. In Nepal, 13 people have died and 5 have gone missing in the last 24 hours due to monsoon disasters and other natural calamities. According to the bulletin published by the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority under the Ministry of Home Affairs, 52 disaster incidents have occurred in 43 districts of the country.

According to the data of the last 24 hours, 43 people have been injured in these incidents and 5 livestock have been lost. Due to the disaster, road traffic has been completely obstructed in 12 places across the country, and physical damage worth an estimated 647,000 rupees has occurred.

The authority has stated that 261 police personnel have been mobilized across the country for disaster response and rescue, and 2 people have been rescued safely. As many as 10 people have lost their lives due to landslides alone.

According to the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology, as of 8:45 AM, rainfall has been measured in 345 out of a total of 414 rainfall measurement centers. Among these, the highest rainfall of 152.9 millimeters was recorded at the Panchmul center in Syangja. The maximum temperature in the last 24 hours was measured at 38.0 degrees Celsius in Rampur, Chitwan, and the lowest at 20.6 degrees Celsius in Lete, Mustang. Similarly, the minimum temperature was recorded at 28.0 degrees Celsius in Biratnagar, Morang, and 8.8 degrees Celsius in Thakufapa and Marpha, Mustang.

A total of 4,659 disaster incidents have occurred across the country from the beginning of the current fiscal year 2083, Baisakh 1 to Shrawan 29. So far, 229 people have died and 9 are still missing in these incidents.

During the same period, 1,463 people were injured, and a total of 5,709 families were directly affected. During the review period, the highest human casualties have been due to snakebites and landslides.

title: Finance Minister Urges Diaspora to Invest in Nepal - Ratopati
description: Finance Minister Urges Diaspora to Invest in Nepal  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle has urged Nepalis living abroad to invest in Nepal with confidence. He expressed this view while wishing success to the 11th Asia Pacific Conference of the Non-Resident Nepali Association (NRNA), which began today in Guangzhou, China, through a video message.

Stating that the government is implementing policy strategies to create an investment environment, generate employment opportunities within the country, and encourage work in AI and information technology sectors, he urged overseas Nepalis to invest in Nepal with confidence.

'Friends abroad, now come to Nepal and invest in Nepal with confidence. Invest in tourism, information technology, green energy, high-value agriculture, and import-substituting sectors,' he said in the video message.

He stated that the government is working at a rapid pace to show results. Finance Minister Wagle said that the government is working to create an investment-friendly environment by bringing in 27 new legal acts through the budget and that the government has paid special attention to creating dignified employment.

He also mentioned that the tax system has been improved to increase government revenue. He noted that the government has steered the ship of economic governance through the budget and that the first year was just the beginning of reforms.

'We started reforms in the first year, and broader reforms will move forward in the second year. Results of the reforms will be visible in the third and fourth years. The public will receive the benefits in the fourth and fifth years,' said Finance Minister Wagle.

He stated that domestic resources are extremely important to achieve all these goals, external investment sources are in a difficult situation, and at this time, the government needs the knowledge and capital of the diaspora.

He said that the issue of mobilizing diaspora capital and investment was also mentioned in the party's manifesto, and the government has also made special efforts.

'We had also talked about utilizing soft power in the election manifesto. Now the government has adopted a policy to bring diaspora investment and knowledge into Nepal. title: Nepal and India's Historical Relationship and Nepali Support for India's Independence - Ratopati

full_article:
A strong pillar of the traditional multifaceted relationship between Nepal and India is also the political relationship between these two countries. There is not only a relationship of bread and daughter between Nepal and India, but also a relationship of art and brotherhood. Just as India has had direct or indirect support in every political change in Nepal, so too did the Nepali people have direct and indirect support in India's independence movement.< p>

Southern neighbor India has entered the 80th year of its independence. The 80th year of independence is a matter of pride, joy, self-respect, and enthusiasm for countries like India. It was only after India became independent that the anti-Rana movement in Nepal also intensified. Three years after India's independence, Nepal was also freed from Rana rule, and democracy was established in the country. The Nepali people provided as much help as possible in India's independence movement. This help from the Nepali people was also in terms of body, mind, and wealth.< p>

The great leader of the Nepali Congress, former party president, and Nepal's first democratically elected Prime Minister, the late Bishweshwor Prasad Koirala, personally participated in India's independence movement. He also published a newspaper called 'Bharat Mata Ki Jai' from Mumbai, India, in support of the movement. He also suffered imprisonment and torture in India's independence movement. There is also a large statue of the late BP Koirala in Patna, the capital of India's Bihar state. Many people in India respect the late BP.< p>

He had a deep relationship and closeness with India's great socialist leaders Jayaprakash Narayan, Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia, Acharya Kripalani, and Narendra Dev. He also had an intimate and deep and friendly relationship with the apostle of truth and non-violence Mahatma Gandhi and India's first Prime Minister Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru. The contribution of the late BP Koirala to India's independence movement will always be respected with honor there. Other contemporary leaders of the Nepali Congress also participated in India's independence movement in one way or another.< p>

title: Nepal-India Relations: A Conversation with Former Foreign Minister NP Saud on India's 80th Independence Day - Ratopati
description: Nepal-India Relations: A Conversation with Former Foreign Minister NP Saud on India's 80th Independence Day  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. India has completed 80 years of freedom from British rule. India is celebrating its 80th Independence Day on August 15, 2026.

Nepal's cooperation is also found in making India free from British rule. Although there was no institutional support from Nepal, Nepali youth and revolutionary leaders living in exile in India were physically involved in the fight against the British.

After India became independent, the movement against the Rana rule intensified in Nepal, and finally, Nepal was freed from the cruel Rana rule. It would not be an exaggeration to say that Nepal and India became 'Azad' around the same time. This is why Nepal-India relations are kept at a high level. Edited excerpts of Ratopati's conversation with former Foreign Minister and Nepali Congress leader NP Saud on the occasion of India's 80th Independence Day regarding Nepal's cooperation in India's freedom struggle and Nepal-India relations:

Today India is celebrating its 80th Independence Day, how do you view the relationship between Nepal and India in this context?

– On the occasion of India's Independence Day, I would like to extend my heartfelt greetings based on the historical relationship between the peoples of the two countries. India's progress has greatly contributed not only to India but also to the progress and development of neighboring countries. Our interests are also linked to India's progress. The more prosperous India becomes, the more positive impact it has on neighboring countries. Therefore, we are directly or indirectly connected with India's progress.

The relationship between Nepal and India is not limited to the governments, politics, or administration of the two countries. This relationship is interdependent at the public, cultural, and emotional levels. Since there is a deep relationship at the public level between both countries, it encompasses every sector including cultural and economic. Nepal-India relations should not be viewed solely from a political or diplomatic perspective; there is also a 'Beti-Roti' or family relationship between the two countries.

It is said that the relationship between Nepal and India is not very good politically at the moment. Is that really the case?

– No, both countries believe in democratic values and systems. We are also based on the same values and systems culturally. Whether the relationship is good or not cannot be evaluated based on any individual or the immediate situation.

In the long term, by setting aside minor obstacles that occasionally arise, no one can weaken the historical and emotional relationship between Nepal and India. There have been various conspiracies to spoil the relationship between the two countries, but both countries are moving forward by setting them aside.

Minor disagreements occur within a family, yet the family continues to function. The relationship between Nepal and India is also like a family. Despite minor disagreements, the relationship between the two countries is excellent in the world. The relationship between India and Nepal cannot be compared with any other country.

Why do you think there are ups and downs in the relationship between the two countries from time to time?

– We are close neighbors, there is no doubt about that. Being close neighbors, many of our concerns are linked to each other. There may be different perspectives in the process of addressing those concerns.

However, we are clear that this cannot shake the foundation of our basic relationship. Regardless of the circumstances between the two countries, the basic relationship remains unchanged. There is a family, economic, social, political, and cultural relationship between the two countries. The geography of the two countries is connected, and one can move freely in each other's country without hesitation. It is normal for minor disputes to occur between countries with such multifaceted relationships. This should be understood in a normal way.

Nepal also cooperated in India's freedom struggle. Please tell us something about this.

– Yes, Nepali leaders were directly involved in India's struggle for independence. Although there was no formal or institutional support from the Government of Nepal, revolutionary leaders of that time, BP Koirala, and leaders of his generation, openly provided support. They were also imprisoned during the movement.

When the fight against the British was ongoing, many Indian leaders stayed in Nepal. At that time, the Rana rulers of Nepal arrested Indian leaders and imprisoned them, and some Nepalis were also imprisoned on charges of helping them. After India became independent, the consciousness that emerged from the Indian freedom struggle played a big role in ending the Rana regime here. Also, India's moral support remained a significant energy for our independence and democratic movement.

What kind of support was provided by Nepal in India's freedom struggle?

– As I said earlier, when Nepali leaders BP Koirala, Krishna Prasad Bhattarai, Matrika Prasad Koirala, and others participated in the 'Quit India' movement, the British government imprisoned them. The participation of leaders from one country in the freedom struggle of another country was perhaps a novel event for the world.

This was possible only because of the high level of relationship between the two countries. The fact that Nepali leaders participated in the fight to make India independent is recorded not only in Nepal's history but also in India's political history.

A statue of BP Koirala has even been erected in India. At that time, the policy of all leaders of the Nepali Congress was that after India became independent, it would help in the effort to get rid of the Rana rule in Nepal. The leaders' expectations were later fulfilled.

What kind of support did India provide at that time to end the Rana regime?

– India provided moral support to the movement against the Rana regime in Nepal. Since preparations for the movement against the Ranas were not possible within Nepal, the leaders prepared while staying in India. The Nepali Congress also organized major conferences, assemblies, and seminars in India at that time, and strategies for the movement were also formulated there. India's moral support was present in all these activities. The main reason for receiving that support was the cooperation of Nepali leaders in the fight against the British. This greatly helped in ending the Rana rule.

Nepal helped India gain independence, after which what was India's perspective towards Nepal?

– The relationship between Nepal and India is multifaceted and connected to many things. In practical work, it is natural for minor obstacles to arise occasionally, and that is not a very significant matter. The structure of our basic relationship is strong, solid, and robust. Since it is maintained at the public level, its basic framework does not change.

There was an ancient and mythological relationship between the two countries, and after Nepali leaders physically assisted in the fight against the British, Nepal's political relationship with India became even stronger. After that, the political relationship between the two countries continued to expand. India's moral support has been present in every democratic, social, and public movement in Nepal.

Since 2007 BS, India's moral support has been present in every movement for change in Nepal – whether for democracy, multi-party system, or the establishment of a republic.

How do you see India's relationship with the current government? What should the government do to further strengthen the relationship?

– There has been a continuous historical relationship between Nepal and India. Whichever government comes, it must continue this. There should be no obstacles to the multifaceted relationship between Nepal and India. If someone seeks to break this continuity, then something seems to have gone wrong.

Therefore, the multifaceted relationship between Nepal and India should be continued and made even stronger and more refined. There should be continuous and cordial visits between the President, Prime Minister, and key figures of the government of one country to the other. This will increase emotional closeness and help resolve some unresolved issues through political understanding. Both Nepal and India must give high importance to each other's friendship.

We are deeply connected with each other from political, cultural, and economic perspectives.

India has completed 80 years of independence, what do you think India should do for Nepal?

– Nepal is a small country compared to its two neighboring countries, and our economy is also small compared to theirs. Economically, our country is still in the developing category. Therefore, India should increase investment in such a way that Nepal's economy becomes strong and stable.

Also, I think India should help reduce Nepal's trade deficit in bilateral trade.
translated:
काठमांडू। भारत ब्रिटिश शासन स मुक्ति क 80 साल पूरा केलक अछि। भारत 15 अगस्त 2026 कए अपन 80म स्वतंत्रता दिवस मना रहल अछि।

नेपालक सहयोग भारतकेँ अंग्रेज शासनसँ मुक्त बनेबामे सेहो भेटैत अछि । नेपाल सँ संस्थागत सहयोग नहि रहला पर भारत मे निर्वासन मे रहनिहार नेपाली युवा आ क्रान्तिकारी नेता सब शारीरिक रूप सँ अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध लड़ाई मे संलग्न छलाह ।

भारत स्वतंत्र भेलाक बाद नेपाल मे राणा शासनक विरुद्ध आन्दोलन तेज भेल, आ अंततः नेपाल क्रूर राणा शासन सँ मुक्त भ गेल । ई कहब अतिशयोक्ति नहि होयत जे नेपाल आ भारत लगभग एकहि समय मे ‘आजाद’ बनि गेल। एहि कारणे नेपाल-भारत संबंध उच्च स्तर पर राखल जाइत अछि । भारतक ८०म स्वतंत्रता दिवसक अवसरमे पूर्व विदेश मन्त्री तथा नेपाली कांग्रेसक नेता एन.पी.

आइ भारत अपन 80म स्वतंत्रता दिवस मना रहल अछि, अहां एहि संदर्भ मे नेपाल आ भारत क संबंध कए कोना देखैत छी?

– भारतक स्वतंत्रता दिवसक अवसर पर हम दुनू देशक लोकक बीच ऐतिहासिक संबंधक आधार पर अपन हार्दिक शुभकामना देबय चाहब। भारत केरऽ प्रगति न॑ खाली भारत म॑ ही नै बल्कि पड़ोसी देशऽ के प्रगति आरू विकास म॑ भी बहुत योगदान देल॑ छै । हमर सबहक हित सेहो भारतक प्रगति स जुड़ल अछि। भारत जतेक समृद्ध होइत अछि, पड़ोसी देश पर ओकर सकारात्मक प्रभाव ओतबे बेसी पड़ैत अछि । तेँ भारतक प्रगति सँ प्रत्यक्ष वा परोक्ष रूपेँ जुड़ल छी ।

नेपाल आ भारतक बीचक संबंध केवल दुनू देशक सरकार, राजनीति, वा प्रशासन धरि सीमित नहि अछि । ई संबंध सार्वजनिक, सांस्कृतिक, आरू भावनात्मक स्तर प॑ परस्पर निर्भर छै । चूँकि दुनू देशक बीच सार्वजनिक स्तर पर गहींर संबंध अछि, एहि मे सांस्कृतिक आ आर्थिक सहित हर क्षेत्र शामिल अछि । नेपाल-भारत सम्बन्ध के केवल राजनीतिक या कूटनीतिक दृष्टिकोण स नहि देखबाक चाही; दुनू देशक बीच ‘बेटी-रोटी’ वा पारिवारिक संबंध सेहो अछि |

कहलऽ जाय छै कि नेपाल आरू भारत के बीच के संबंध अभी राजनीतिक रूप स॑ बहुत अच्छा नै छै । की सचमुच एहन बात अछि?

– नै, दुनू देश लोकतांत्रिक मूल्य आ व्यवस्था मे विश्वास करैत अछि । हम सब सांस्कृतिक रूप स सेहो ओही मूल्य आ व्यवस्था पर आधारित छी। संबंध नीक अछि वा नहि एकर मूल्यांकन कोनो व्यक्ति वा तत्काल स्थितिक आधार पर नहि कयल जा सकैत अछि ।

दीर्घकाल मे बीच-बीच मे जे छोट-छोट बाधा उत्पन्न होइत अछि ओकरा एक कात राखि नेपाल आ भारतक ऐतिहासिक आ भावनात्मक संबंध केँ कियो कमजोर नहि क' सकैत अछि । दुनू देशक बीच संबंध बिगाड़बाक लेल विभिन्न तरहक साजिश रचल गेल अछि, मुदा दुनू देश एकरा एक कात राखि आगू बढ़ि रहल अछि।

परिवारक भीतर छोट-मोट मतभेद होइत अछि, तइयो परिवारक काज चलैत रहैत अछि। नेपाल आ भारतक संबंध सेहो परिवार जकाँ अछि । छोट-मोट असहमति के बावजूद दुनू देश के बीच संबंध दुनिया मे उत्कृष्ट अछि. भारत आ नेपालक बीचक संबंधक तुलना कोनो आन देशसँ नहि कएल जा सकैत अछि ।

अहाँक विचारे बीच-बीच मे दुनू देशक संबंध मे उतार-चढ़ाव किएक होइत अछि?

– हम सभ करीबी पड़ोसी छी, एहि मे कोनो संदेह नहि। करीबी पड़ोसी होय के कारण हमरऽ बहुत चिंता एक-दूसरा स॑ जुड़लऽ छै । ओहि चिंता कें संबोधित करय कें प्रक्रिया मे अलग-अलग दृष्टिकोण भ सकय छै.

ओना हम सब स्पष्ट छी जे एहि स हमर सबहक मूल संबंध क नींव नहि हिल सकैत अछि। दुनू देशक बीच चाहे जे कोनो परिस्थिति हो, मूल संबंध अपरिवर्तित अछि। दुनू देशक बीच पारिवारिक, आर्थिक, सामाजिक, राजनीतिक, आ सांस्कृतिक संबंध अछि । दुनू देशक भूगोल जुड़ल अछि, आ एक दोसराक देश मे बिना कोनो संकोच के स्वतंत्र रूप सँ घुमि सकैत अछि । एहन बहुआयामी संबंध वाला देशक बीच छोट-मोट विवाद होएब सामान्य अछि. एकरा सामान्य तरीका स बुझबाक चाही।

भारतक स्वतंत्रता संग्राम मे सेहो नेपाल सहयोग केलक । एहि विषय मे किछु बताउ।

– हँ, भारतक स्वतंत्रताक संघर्ष मे नेपाली नेता लोकनि सोझे संलग्न छलाह । नेपाल सरकार दिससँ औपचारिक वा संस्थागत सहयोग यद्यपि नहि छल मुदा ओहि समयक क्रान्तिकारी नेता बी.पी. आन्दोलन के दौरान सेहो जेल मे बंद भ गेल छल।

जखन अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध लड़ाई चलि रहल छल तखन कतेको भारतीय नेता नेपाल मे रहलाह । ओहि समय नेपालक राणा शासक भारतीय नेता सब के गिरफ्तार क जेल में बंद क देलक, आ किछु नेपाली के सेहो मदद के आरोप में जेल में बंद क देल गेल। भारत के स्वतंत्र भेला के बाद भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम स जे चेतना निकलल छल ओ एतय राणा शासन के समाप्त करय में बहुत पैघ भूमिका निभेलक। साथ ही भारत केरऽ नैतिक समर्थन हमरऽ स्वतंत्रता आरू लोकतांत्रिक आन्दोलन लेली एगो महत्वपूर्ण ऊर्जा बनलऽ रहलै ।

भारतक स्वतंत्रता संग्राम मे नेपाल द्वारा केहन सहयोग देल गेल?

– जेना कि हम पहिने कहलहुँ जे नेपाली नेता बी.पी. एक देश के नेता के दोसर देश के स्वतंत्रता संग्राम में भागीदारी शायद दुनिया के लेल एकटा नवीन घटना छल।

ई संभव भेल केवल दुनू देशक बीच उच्च स्तरक संबंधक कारण । भारत के स्वतंत्र बनेबाक लड़ाई में नेपाली नेता सब के सहभागिता नेपाल के इतिहास में नै बल्कि भारत के राजनीतिक इतिहास में सेहो दर्ज अछि ।

भारत मे बीपी कोइराला के मूर्ति तक ठाढ़ भ गेल अछि। ओहि समय नेपाली कांग्रेसक सभ नेताक नीति छल जे भारत स्वतंत्र भेलाक बाद नेपाल मे राणा शासन सँ मुक्ति भेटबाक प्रयास मे सहायक होयत । नेता लोकनिक अपेक्षा बाद मे पूरा भेल।

राणा शासन के समाप्त करय लेल ओहि समय भारत केहन सहयोग देलक?

– नेपाल मे राणा शासन के विरुद्ध आन्दोलन के भारत नैतिक सहयोग प्रदान केलक । नेपाल के भीतर राणा के खिलाफ आन्दोलन के तैयारी संभव नै छल, ताहि लेल नेता सब भारत में रहैत तैयारी केलनि। नेपाली कांग्रेस सेहो ओहि समय भारत मे पैघ सम्मेलन, सभा, गोष्ठी के आयोजन करैत छल, आ ओतहि आन्दोलन के रणनीति सेहो बनैत छल | एहि सब गतिविधि मे भारतक नैतिक समर्थन उपस्थित छल । ओ समर्थन भेटबाक मुख्य कारण छल अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध लड़ाई मे नेपाली नेता लोकनिक सहयोग । एहि स राणा शासन समाप्त करबा मे बहुत मदद भेटल।

नेपाल भारत के स्वतंत्रता प्राप्त करय में मदद केलक, जकर बाद भारत के नेपाल के प्रति की दृष्टिकोण छल ?

– नेपाल आ भारतक बीचक संबंध बहुआयामी अछि आ बहुत रास बातसँ जुड़ल अछि । व्यावहारिक काज मे यदा-कदा छोट-मोट बाधा उठब स्वाभाविक अछि, आ से कोनो बेसी महत्वपूर्ण बात नहि अछि । हमरऽ मूल संबंध के संरचना मजबूत, ठोस, आरू मजबूत छै । चूँकि एकरा सार्वजनिक स्तर पर कायम राखल गेल अछि, एकर मूल रूपरेखा मे कोनो बदलाव नहि होइत अछि ।

दुनू देशक बीच प्राचीन आ पौराणिक संबंध छल, आ अंग्रेजक विरुद्ध लड़ाई मे नेपाली नेता लोकनिक शारीरिक सहायताक बाद भारतक संग नेपालक राजनीतिक संबंध आओर मजबूत भेल । एकर बाद दुनू देशक राजनीतिक संबंधक विस्तार होइत रहल। भारतक नैतिक समर्थन नेपालक प्रत्येक लोकतान्त्रिक, सामाजिक, आ जन आन्दोलन मे उपस्थित रहल अछि ।

२००७ बी.एस.सँ नेपालमे परिवर्तनक प्रत्येक आन्दोलनमे भारतक नैतिक समर्थन उपस्थित रहल अछि – चाहे ओ लोकतंत्र हो, बहुदलीय व्यवस्था हो, वा गणतंत्रक स्थापनाक लेल हो ।

वर्तमान सरकार सं भारत के संबंध केहन देखैत छी? संबंध आओर मजबूत करय लेल सरकार के की करबाक चाही?

– नेपाल आ भारतक बीच निरंतर ऐतिहासिक संबंध रहल अछि । जे सरकार आबय, ओकरा ई जारी राखय पड़तैक। नेपाल आ भारतक बहुआयामी संबंध मे कोनो बाधा नहि होबाक चाही। जँ कियो एहि निरंतरता केँ तोड़बाक प्रयास करैत अछि तखन किछु गड़बड़ भ' गेल बुझाइत अछि।

अतः नेपाल आ भारतक बहुआयामी सम्बन्ध केँ जारी राखि आओर मजबूत आ परिष्कृत करबाक चाही । राष्ट्रपति, प्रधानमंत्री, आरू एक देश केरऽ सरकार केरऽ प्रमुख हस्ती सिनी के बीच दोसरऽ देश के बीच लगातार आरू सौहार्दपूर्ण दौरा होना चाहियऽ । एहि सं भावनात्मक निकटता बढ़त आओर राजनीतिक समझदारी के माध्यम सं किछ अनसुलझल मुद्दा के समाधान मे मदद मिलत. नेपाल आ भारत दुनू एक दोसराक मित्रता केँ बेसी महत्व देबाक चाही।

हम सब राजनीतिक, सांस्कृतिक, आ आर्थिक दृष्टिकोण स एक दोसरा स गहींर जुड़ल छी।

भारत के आजादी के 80 साल पूरा भ गेल अछि, अहां के कि लगैत अछि जे भारत के नेपाल के लेल की करबाक चाही?

– नेपाल अपन दुनू पड़ोसी देशक तुलना मे छोट देश अछि, आ हमर अर्थव्यवस्था सेहो हुनका लोकनिक तुलना मे छोट अछि । आर्थिक रूप स हमर देश एखनो विकासशील श्रेणी मे अछि। अतः भारत के निवेश के एहन वृद्धि करबाक चाही जे नेपाल के अर्थव्यवस्था मजबूत आ स्थिर भ जाय ।

title: Nepal Oil Corporation Mandates ID for LPG Gas Distribution Amidst Public Criticism - Ratopati
description: Nepal Oil Corporation Mandates ID for LPG Gas Distribution Amidst Public Criticism  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The Nepal Oil Corporation has faced widespread criticism for making citizenship or identity cards mandatory for citizens coming to collect cooking LPG gas, in an effort to streamline gas distribution. Citizens are expressing dissatisfaction with this arrangement through social media and various other platforms.

The corporation had issued a notice on Friday, informing about the arrangement for selling and distributing gas from five locations in the Kathmandu Valley on Saturday. The notice stated that a citizenship certificate and national identity card must be brought when coming to collect gas.

Widespread criticism has arisen after the corporation made citizenship and national identity cards mandatory for collecting gas. According to Nepal Oil Corporation spokesperson Manoj Thakur, this arrangement has been made to ensure that gas distribution is orderly, transparent, and reaches genuine consumers. He stated that it has been observed that some individuals were taking multiple cylinders of gas and stocking them up.

As a result, consumers who genuinely need gas immediately have been deprived. The corporation's clarification is that this measure has been implemented to solve this problem and to keep a record of genuinely needy consumers to provide them with gas easily, by making identification documents mandatory.

Spokesperson Thakur also stated that even without a citizenship or national identity card, gas can be collected if the individual has other identification documents that confirm their identity (such as a voter ID card, student ID card, or other official documents). He claimed that by distributing gas upon presentation of identification documents, a clear record will be maintained of who received how much, and black marketing and unnecessary hoarding will be prevented.

Spokesperson Thakur said that this arrangement is not intended to trouble any citizen but is a step taken to ensure gas for genuinely needy consumers who require it immediately. The corporation has informed that it will not deprive any citizen through this arrangement and has urged its depots and vendors to prioritize providing gas to consumers facing genuine problems.

title: India, Nepal set three-year target to map disputed cross-border land occupation - Firstpost
description: India, Nepal set three-year target to map disputed cross-border land occupation  Firstpost
publisher.title: Firstpost
full_article:
India and Nepal have agreed to complete the mapping of land occupied across their shared border within three years, giving a fresh push to a long-running technical issue that has affected communities on both sides.

The exercise will use unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to identify and document areas where people from one country are cultivating or living on land that falls within the territory of the other. The joint survey is expected to begin after the monsoon, around September or October.

According to The Kathmandu Post , the decision was taken at the 13th meeting of the Survey Officials' Committee (SOC), which concluded in Lucknow on Friday. The meeting also approved the annual plan and budget for carrying out the survey. The UAVs will be used to capture aerial images, which will then be analysed jointly to establish the extent of cross-border occupation.

Advertisement

Why land occupation became a border issue

The problem is linked partly to changes in the courses of rivers along the Nepal-India border. When the boundary was originally demarcated, the Fixed Boundary Principle was used in several riverine areas. Over the years, shifting river channels moved land from one side of the boundary to the other.

As a result, residents of both countries have, in some places, continued to cultivate or live on land that technically falls across the border.

The issue gained wider attention after Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah told Parliament in May that he had learned that land was being occupied by citizens of both Nepal and India. Nepal's Foreign Ministry later clarified that the reference was to cross-border occupation and use of land, rather than a formal territorial claim by either country.

More from India

The 182 sets of strip maps signed by the two countries in 2007 had already identified hundreds of hectares where citizens of one country were cultivating or residing on land belonging to the other.

UAV survey to provide technical basis

The latest exercise is aimed at creating a common technical assessment of the disputed and occupied areas rather than immediately deciding ownership.

The SOC works under the Boundary Working Group (BWG), which is headed by the survey chiefs of Nepal and India. Joint Field Survey Teams carry out technical work on the ground, including documenting changes and examining boundary markers.

The BWG had agreed in 2025 to complete technical boundary work within three years. This includes constructing new boundary pillars and repairing damaged ones, although the Susta and Kalapani-Limpiyadhura-Lipulekh areas remain outside that timeline.

Advertisement

Thousands of boundary pillars need repair

Nepal and India share a border of about 1,880 kilometres across 27 districts. According to Nepal's Department of Survey, 8,554 boundary pillars have been installed along the border.

However, 1,325 pillars are missing, while another 1,956 are partially or completely damaged. Their maintenance and reconstruction are among the key responsibilities of the BWG and its technical teams.

The two countries have previously struggled to meet deadlines for completing such work. A three-year target set in 2015 was missed, while a revised deadline agreed in 2017 aimed for completion by 2022.

Funding problems, the Covid-19 pandemic, recurring boundary disputes and difficult weather conditions contributed to further delays.

Efforts to improve technical border management gained momentum after Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi's 2014 visit to Nepal, when the two sides agreed to establish the BWG.

The new three-year deadline, backed by UAV-based mapping, is intended to provide both countries with clearer data on the ground and a technical basis for addressing one of the more complicated aspects of their open border.

भारत आरू नेपाल न॑ अपनऽ साझा सीमा पार प॑ कब्जा करलऽ गेलऽ जमीन के नक्शा बनाबै के काम तीन साल के भीतर पूरा करै प॑ सहमत होय गेलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ लंबा समय स॑ चलै वाला तकनीकी मुद्दा क॑ नया धक्का देलऽ गेलऽ छै जेकरा स॑ दूनू तरफ के समुदाय प्रभावित होय गेलऽ छै ।

ई अभ्यास म॑ मानव रहित हवाई जहाज (यूएवी) के इस्तेमाल करी क॑ ऐन्हऽ क्षेत्रऽ के पहचान आरू दस्तावेजीकरण करलऽ जैतै, जहां एक देश के लोग दोसरऽ देश के क्षेत्र म॑ आबै वाला जमीन प॑ खेती करी रहलऽ छै या रह॑ छै । मानसून के बाद, सितंबर या अक्टूबर के आसपास संयुक्त सर्वेक्षण शुरू होय के उम्मीद छै.

द काठमांडू पोस्ट के अनुसार शुक्रदिन लखनऊ मे समाप्त भेल सर्वेक्षण अधिकारी समिति के 13म बैसार मे ई निर्णय लेल गेल अछि। बैसार मे सर्वेक्षण करबाक वार्षिक योजना आ बजट कए सेहो मंजूरी देल गेल। यूएवी के उपयोग हवाई तस्वीर कैप्चर करै लेली करलौ जैतै, जेकरौ बाद संयुक्त रूप स॑ विश्लेषण करी क॑ सीमा पार स॑ कब्जा के हद क॑ स्थापित करलऽ जैतै ।

विज्ञापन

जमीन पर कब्जा सीमाक मुद्दा किएक बनि गेल

ई समस्या कुछ हद तक नेपाल-भारत सीमा के किनारे नदी के प्रवाह में बदलाव स॑ जुड़लऽ छै । जखन मूलतः सीमा निर्धारित कयल गेल छल तखन कतेको नदीक कात मे निश्चित सीमा सिद्धांतक प्रयोग कयल गेल छल | वर्षोॅ में नदी के चैनल के शिफ्ट होय के कारण सीमा के एक तरफ सें दोसरऽ तरफ जमीन के स्थानांतरित होय गेलै ।

एकरऽ परिणाम ई छै कि दोनों देशऽ के निवासी, कुछ जगहऽ प॑, तकनीकी रूप स॑ सीमा के पार गिरै वाला जमीन प॑ खेती या रहना जारी रखन॑ छै ।

नेपालक प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाह नेपाल आ भारत दुनू देशक नागरिकक भूमि पर कब्जा भऽ रहल अछि, से माईमे संसदमे बतौला के बाद ई मुद्दा पर व्यापक ध्यान आएल छल । बाद मे नेपालक विदेश मन्त्रालय स्पष्ट केलक जे संदर्भ कोनो देशक औपचारिक क्षेत्रीय दावा नहि, सीमा पार क कब्जा आ जमीनक उपयोगक अछि ।

भारत स बेसी

2007 मे दूनू देश द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित 182 सेट पट्टी नक्शा मे सैकड़ों हेक्टेयर क पहचान भ चुकल छल, जतय एक देश क नागरिक दोसर देश क जमीन पर खेती क रहल छथि या निवास क रहल छथि।

तकनीकी आधार प्रदान करय लेल यूएवी सर्वेक्षण

नवीनतम अभ्यास कें उद्देश्य तुरंत स्वामित्व कें फैसला करय कें बजाय विवादित आ कब्जा वाला क्षेत्रक कें एकटा साझा तकनीकी आकलन बनानाय छै.

एसओसी सीमा कार्यदल (बीडब्ल्यूजी) के तहत काज करैत अछि, जेकर नेतृत्व नेपाल आ भारत के सर्वेक्षण प्रमुख करैत छथि । संयुक्त क्षेत्र सर्वेक्षण टीमक जमीन पर तकनीकी काज करएयत छै, जइ मे परिवर्तनक कें दस्तावेजीकरण आ सीमा चिह्नक कें जांच शामिल छै.

बीडब्ल्यूजी 2025 मे तीन साल क भीतर तकनीकी सीमा क काज पूरा करबा पर सहमत भ गेल छल। एहि मे नव सीमा खंभा क निर्माण आ क्षतिग्रस्त क मरम्मत सेहो शामिल अछि, हालांकि सुस्ता आ कालापानी-लिम्पियाधुरा-लिपुलेख क्षेत्र ओहि समय रेखा स बाहर अछि।

विज्ञापन

हजारों सीमा खंभा कए मरम्मत क जरूरत अछि

नेपाल आ भारतक सीमा २७ जिला मे लगभग १,८८० किलोमीटर अछि । नेपालक सर्वेक्षण विभागक अनुसार सीमाक कातमे ८,५५४ सीमा स्तम्भ लगाओल गेल अछि ।

मुदा 1325 खंभा गायब अछि, जखन कि 1956 आओर आंशिक या पूर्ण रूप स क्षतिग्रस्त अछि। एकरऽ रखरखाव आरू पुनर्निर्माण बीडब्ल्यूजी आरू ओकरऽ तकनीकी टीम केरऽ प्रमुख जिम्मेदारी म॑ शामिल छै ।

एहि तरहक काज पूरा करबाक समय सीमा पूरा करबा मे दुनू देश पहिने सेहो संघर्षरत रहल अछि। 2015 मे निर्धारित तीन साल क लक्ष्य छूटि गेल, जखन कि 2017 मे सहमत संशोधित समय सीमा 2022 तक पूरा करबाक लक्ष्य छल।

फंडिंग के समस्या, कोविड-19 महामारी, बार-बार सीमा विवाद आ कठिन मौसम के स्थिति आओर देरी मे योगदान देलक।

भारतीय प्रधानमंत्री नरेन्द्र मोदी केरऽ २०१४ म॑ नेपाल यात्रा के बाद तकनीकी सीमा प्रबंधन म॑ सुधार के प्रयास म॑ तेजी आबी गेलै, जब॑ दोनों पक्ष बीडब्ल्यूजी केरऽ स्थापना करै प॑ सहमत होय गेलै ।

यूएवी आधारित मानचित्रण के समर्थन स॑ बनलऽ ई नया तीन साल के समय सीमा के उद्देश्य दूनू देशऽ क॑ जमीन प॑ स्पष्ट आंकड़ा आरू अपनऽ खुला सीमा केरऽ एगो अधिक जटिल पहलू क॑ संबोधित करै लेली तकनीकी आधार उपलब्ध करैना छै ।
